communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Michigan Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Please provide existing records of completed audits or compliance reviews of Flock Safety ALPR systems used by or for the City of Pontiac, for January 1 through October 31, 2026, including:

1. Completed audit reports, review checklists, or summaries documenting review of searches, search purposes or case numbers, user access, or external agency sharing.
2. Findings of policy violations or other exceptions identified through those reviews.
3. Records documenting corrective action or resolution of those findings.

This includes responsive records maintained by the City concerning reviews performed by the Oakland County Sheriff’s Office on Pontiac’s behalf. This request seeks existing records and does not ask the City to conduct a new audit or create a report.

Please provide records electronically and on a rolling basis. If no responsive records are located for an item, please indicate that in the response. If any portion is withheld or redacted, please identify the applicable statutory exemption. Please advise me before incurring substantial charges.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Scott Gifford

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Michigan Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Flock Data Policies & Rules: All current policies, rules, internal guidelines, data-retention guidelines, access-control policies, and privacy protocols governing the use, collection, sharing, access, and ownership of data generated by Flock Safety devices or services used by or for the City of Pontiac or its departments, including but not limited to permitted and prohibited uses, documentation of search purposes, approval and termination of external agency sharing, account security, hotlist management, and retention of downloaded or exported data.

Please include applicable Oakland County Sheriff’s Office policies maintained by the City.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Scott Gifford
